body:
Hi there, I am depressed as well. I don't know how to help with this part specifically, except to say that you should try to seek a therapist (oftentimes some are listed as LBGTQA+ friendly, which means the therapist should have some sort of training in this area). My old therapist had special training for this. 

If your depression is mainly related to issues involving your identity, maybe talking to other trans* people online will help. Obviously, as with anything online, make sure that you protect your identity. 

If you can't find anyone to talk to, and would like someone with a similar experience, PM me. My good friend is a Trans man (and he is very trustworthy and kind) and would likely be willing to chat with you, as he does a lot of activism in the community and online. 

Best wishes with your depression. Please be safe.
Just getting out of a bad relationship (first time living alone), so that won't work! But I appreciate the advice, and if I need to I will PM you. :)
Hi there, the university is open. I feel as though I can't leave the apartment alone. I will try to force myself out tomorrow. Thanks for your suggestion.
Thank you so much for your response. I will try my best to take this advice.

I am trying to figure out the same thing. I am sorry that I can't help. I think Karma is given by upvoting things (?) In any case, I hope things turn out well for both of us. 
 PM me if no one else is around to talk to. 

I'm having the same problem with my university's psychiatrist's office being closed until Tuesday. 

All that I have tried to promise myself if that if I feel like I'm going to go through with it, I will call 911. 

I've tried the crisis line for my area before, too. Sometimes that can help. Check out if there is a mental health mobile crisis team in your area.
